howLookupWorks: src/story/dsl.ts SpeakerId is the id say() takes. src/ui/common/portrait.ts (portraitImgHtml/faceImgHtml/faceImgHtmlFrom) resolves a speaker or combatant id straight to public/art/portraits/<id>.png unless a SayStep sets an explicit `portrait` override (none of the shipped scripts do). A combatant's HUD chip (CTB list, party status row, prep roster, results row, pause dossier) instead uses its data-file `portraitKey` via src/engine/BattlePresenterArt.ts artIdFor(), which for FFX-2 Yuna/Rikku already points at the existing FFX 'yuna'/'rikku' portraits (so those two only 404 as *dialogue* speakers, not in battle HUD).
